segments.name: Swim fees
products: Private Swimming Lessons and Aquatic Sports
segments.description: Swimming lessons for Singapore public-school students under the government SwimSafer program, plus private lessons and aquatic sports.
segments.evidence: Fitness Champs carries on the business of sports education in the form of swimming lessons provided through government related contracts through Singapore's national SwimSafer program.

segments.name: Sales of merchandise
segments.description: Branded swim goggles, caps, swimsuits and flotation devices sold alongside lessons; the filing says it generates no material revenue.
segments.evidence: From swimming goggles, swim caps, and swimsuits to various flotation devices, our merchandise is not only functional but also bears the distinct mark of our identity.

segments.name: Pickleball
segments.description: Pickleball revenue reported as its own revenue stream beside swim fees and merchandise; the filing gives no detail on it.

revenueModel.text: Government contracts fund school swimming lessons, while private lesson and merchandise revenue comes from consumers.
